name: Speciality Single Origin Chikmagalur Region
description: Situated in the beautiful Chikmagalur region of Karnataka, we are proud producers of hand-picked and sun-dried Arabica coffee. Our coffee plants grow alongside pepper, cacao, and cardamom, creating a vibrant blend of flavors. When you savor a cup of our coffee, you'll experience the delightful combination of sweet honey and raisin. And to add a touch of fruity goodness, there's a juicy peach note that perfectly balances the overall taste. It's a coffee that's carefully crafted to deliver a truly satisfying and enjoyable experience.

name: Speciality Single Origin Bababudangiri Region
description: Embark on a remarkable journey through the rich heritage of coffee cultivation in the hallowed grounds of Baba Budan Giri hills. This renowned destination, named after the legendary merchant Baba Budan, who deftly transported precious coffee seeds from Yemen, stands as the embodiment of India's esteemed coffee culture. Immerse yourself in our exceptional roast, where you will discover a delightful interplay of flavors. Experience the gentle sweetness of juicy passionfruit balanced by the lively brightness of pineapple. As the temperature gradually descends, a captivating essence of richer molasses emerges, offering a truly indulgent sensation. This coffee is meticulously crafted through a natural processing method, wherein the coffee beans are dried alongside the cherry, resulting in a remarkable symphony of complex, fruity, and sweet flavors. Only the finest, fully ripened cherries are meticulously handpicked, expertly sorted, and sun-dried on African raised beds, ensuring a pristine and flawless quality.

name: Monsoon Malabar
description: Experience the rich essence of our Monsoon Malabar coffee, a tribute to age-old traditions from the British Raj's seafaring days. This brew is an earthy symphony of bold flavors, infused with the warmth of aromatic spices and deep, dark chocolate notes. Perfectly balanced for any time of day, it’s a cup you’ll want to savor again and again. Our tip? Keep a second bag close—you won’t be able to resist a refill.

name: Signature South Indian Filter
description: Inspired by the classic South Indian coffee, our blend is a bold tribute to tradition. The rich, burnt caramel notes of Arabica Washed coffee perfectly complement the smooth, syrupy texture of Robusta Natural, creating a robust yet comforting flavor. With hints of milk chocolate and roasted almonds, this blend shines whether paired with milk and sugar, as a strong espresso, or brewed in a Moka Pot.

name: French Roast
description: Hailing from the misty green hills of Karnataka's Nilgiris, this exquisite dark roast is a true indulgence. With rich notes of toffee, roasted hazelnut, and the subtle crunch of cocoa nibs, each sip offers a full-bodied experience with a bittersweet undertone. Enjoy this decadent brew and let it whisk you away to a sunny day at a cozy Parisian café.

name: El Diablo
description: Our house blend might just remind you of dessert, and we’re perfectly okay with that. With bold notes of zesty orange, rich chocolate, and sweet brown sugar, this coffee is big-bodied, well-structured, and deeply complex. It’s what keeps our team at Third Wave Coffee going strong. Potent and flavorful on its own, or decadently indulgent with milk or cream, every sip is a delightful experience.

name: Vienna Roast
description: Discover the richness of our Vienna Roast, a smooth, dark blend that offers a decadent combination of flavors. Indulge in the deep, bittersweet taste of dark chocolate, complemented by the sweet warmth of the subtle crunch of toasted Nuts. Crafted for a refined coffee experience, it’s a perfect pick for those who crave a bold yet silky-smooth cup.
